description: This Java class implements a command handling strategy for modifying features within 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It processes the 'ModifyFeature' command, performing size validation, feature extraction, and event creation for modifications or creation of features on 'thing' entities.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles the 'ModifyFeature' command by extending an abstract command strategy, implementing logic for feature modification or creation, size validation, and event generation within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the main logic to handle the modify feature command, including feature extraction, size validation, and deciding whether to modify or create a feature.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specific feature from the 'thing' based on the feature ID provided in the command.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs the result and event indicating a feature has been modified.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs the result and event indicating a new feature has been created.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag for concurrency control based on the previous entity state.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the updated entity after modification.
